proposed.name: Traffic deaths
proposed.line: I worry about people getting killed or badly hurt on the roads around here.

alternatives.name: Traffic deaths
alternatives.line: I worry about people getting killed or badly hurt on the roads around here.

why.detail: About 1.16 million people die in road crashes each year (WHO).
